why.v_light_dpo: Start from lora_v_merged, not the exp6 contrast adapter. beta 0.05 is half of exp6 0.1. lr 2e-6 is below exp6 5e-6. The pair cap 141 is half of exp6's 282 pairs, so one epoch is about half the steps. Frame-break and marker-leak answers are forced onto the rejected side.
why.v_light_contrast: One epoch, unlikelihood weight 0.4 instead of 1.0, lr 5e-5 instead of 1e-4. Negatives are FRAME regex or marker fail_hits only, at most 2 per prompt. The 1304-row voice SFT mix from exp6 is not repeated.
why.v_light_combo: Light contrast adapter, then DPO at beta 0.03, lr 1e-6, and 70 steps (about half of the 141-pair set). Milder than stage (a) and milder than exp6's beta 0.1 / lr 5e-6 / 282 steps.
why.v_light_dpo_replay: Same curated pairs as (a), plus CE on about 8% facts.jsonl rows (under the 25% exp6 v_replay mix). beta 0.04, lr 1.5e-6, init lora_v_merged. Must-matching fact rows are preferred so the 59/60 gap has a chance to close.
why.sweep: After (a)-(c), if no RAG row passes and one final is close (must >= 59, marker <= 2, frames < 6, voice >= 4.15), evaluate the earliest checkpoint and the checkpoint nearest half the run. Select the RAG row with the highest voice among rows that pass the bar.
